source_row.rationale: Calcium is generally better absorbed when taken in smaller, divided doses throughout the day (such as with meals) rather than one large single dose, since absorption capacity is limited at any given time, an important teaching point for optimizing supplementation effectiveness.
source_row.source_name: National Osteoporosis Foundation — Calcium Supplementation Guidance
